task: From the notebook brief, locate a plausible real issue/fix/test chain and test its applicability to the selected release/branch rather than accepting the apparent chain. A genuinely misleading/version-mismatched chain must exist for that narrower diagnostic result; otherwise mark that facet unassessed.
question: Use one real fix chain and one misleading or version-mismatched apparent chain. For discovery cells the candidate must locate the chain itself.
source_scope: BRIEF_ONLY live public discovery and independent code precedents; candidate finds chain itself. No evaluator-picked repository or failure answer.
control: Documentation-first investigation with normal access to repositories, issues and tests.
treatment: Follow selected consequential mechanisms through entry points, real issue history, fixes and regression tests; compare at least two independent implementations where the case requires it.
measure: Verified lessons, version/branch applicability, unsupported causal links, executable behavior, novelty, code-reading cost and recommendation impact.
integration_limit: An issue title is a lead, not consensus; a merged patch is not automatically evidence of the affected release or a reproduced defect.
family_binding_rule: Within pair identical actual supported family/model/effort. Root may version an unstarted card prospectively if route unavailable; preserve original planned family and reason. No substitution attributed as same-model replication.

execution_policy.factor_enforcement: V01 control critic physically lacks execution, not only text prohibition; otherwise tools equal unless documented factor is retrieval ordering/representation.

important_checks.question: Do the same predeclared consequential source/behavior claims receive correct supported correction or preservation under this method, without a new consequential error?
Does the final retain supported conditions, legitimate uncertainty and required useful content rather than blanket rejection or incomplete delivery?
Was the declared mechanism actually taken up with honest source/execution scope, and what critical/false-rejection/repair differences appear under matched budgets?

candidate_authorship: All substantive scored candidate checking, integration and code remain affordable candidate-native Goal work; Sol only scenario/protocol/evaluator infrastructure.
